Route Module: default component.description:
**Framework mode.** The route's default export renders when the path matches.
It receives `loaderData`, `actionData`, `params` and `matches` as props — no `useLoaderData()` needed in Framework mode.
Types come from the generated `./+types/<route>` module.

Route Module: loader (server).description:
**Framework mode.** Runs on the server before the route renders. Server-only — the code is removed from the browser bundle.
`url` is the normalized URL used for routing; `request.url` is the raw one.
Return a plain object; it reaches the component as `loaderData`.

Route Module: clientLoader.description:
**Framework mode.** Runs in the browser. Use it for client-only data, or alongside `loader` to cache/augment server data.
Set `clientLoader.hydrate = true` to also run it on the initial hydration.

**Framework mode.** `serverLoader()` calls this route's server `loader` from the client.
`hydrate = true` makes the client loader run during hydration as well — pair it with a `HydrateFallback`.

**Framework mode.** Handles non-GET requests (form submissions). Server-only.
After it resolves, all loaders on the page revalidate automatically.

Route Module: clientAction.description: **Framework mode.** Browser-side action. `serverAction()` delegates to this route's server `action`.

Route Module: meta.description:
**Framework mode.** Returns the `<meta>` and `<title>` tags for this route, rendered by the `<Meta />` component in root.
Read this route's data from `loaderData`, and a parent's from `matches[i].loaderData` — the old `data` field was removed in v8.

Route Module: links.description:
**Framework mode.** Returns `<link>` descriptors, rendered by the `<Links />` component in root.
Use it for stylesheets, preloads and icons scoped to this route.

Route Module: headers.description:
**Framework mode.** HTTP headers for the document response of this route. Server-only.
Only the leaf-most route's `headers` is used unless parents are merged explicitly.

Route Module: ErrorBoundary.description:
**Framework mode.** Renders in place of the route when its loader, action or component throws.
Requires `import { isRouteErrorResponse } from 'react-router'` to tell thrown Responses from real errors.

Route Module: HydrateFallback.description:
**Framework mode.** Shown during the initial hydration while a `clientLoader` with `hydrate = true` runs.
Only applies to the first render — later navigations use `useNavigation()` instead.

Route Module: shouldRevalidate.description:
**Framework mode.** Opt this route's loader out of revalidation after actions or navigations.
Return `false` to keep the existing `loaderData`. Use sparingly — stale data is the usual bug.

Route Module: middleware.description:
**Framework mode.** Runs on the server before and after the loaders/actions below it. Use for auth, logging and response post-processing.
Calling `next()` continues down the chain. Enabled by default since v8 — no future flag needed.

Route Module: clientMiddleware.description:
**Framework mode.** Browser-side middleware, running around client loaders and actions.
Enabled by default since v8 — no future flag needed.

Route Module: handle.description:
**Framework mode.** Arbitrary per-route data, readable from any component via `useMatches()`.
The usual use is breadcrumbs — see the `rr-breadcrumbs` snippet.

Route Module: Layout (root).description:
**Framework mode.** Wraps every route, including error states. Defined in `root.tsx`.
It must render the document shell — `<Meta />`, `<Links />`, `<ScrollRestoration />` and `<Scripts />`.
